reason: Not a producer defect: VRM Add-on behaviour. Before its VRM 1.0 loader runs, the add-on pre-fills all 55 VRM 0.x humanoid slots, then logs once for each mapped VRM 1.0 bone. Reproduced without any Potter data: the add-on's own basic humanoid (icyp.make_basic_armature) exported as VRM 1.0 and re-imported logs 53 such notices.

Not a producer defect: the add-on asks for confirmation for any otherPermissionUrl it does not whitelist (importer/license_validation.py). Potter writes that URL on purpose in the VRM 0.x legacy meta (fixture/spec.mjs META.legacy). The probe accepts the prompt through the add-on's switch; the url and json_key lines are asserted separately.
